title: E2E: owner sends message and retrieves via Message/get
description:
What: End-to-end integration test: owner creates a contact, creates a chat, sends a message via Message/set create, retrieves it via Message/get, verifies JMAP response shape and field values.

Algorithm:
1. Open in-memory Store::open_in_memory().
2. Initialize test AppState with mock WhoIsProvider returning owner identity.
3. Build full axum Router via test helper (same as main.rs but in-memory store).
4. POST /.well-known/jmap → assert Session response shape.
5. Contact/set create: { create: { c0: { tailscaleUserId, login, mailboxHost } } } → assert created.c0 has server id.
6. Chat/set create: { create: { c0: { contactId: <from step 5> } } } → assert created.c0 has deterministic chat id.
7. Message/set create: { create: { m0: { chatId, body: "hello", bodyType: "text/plain" } } } → assert created.m0 has id, deliveryState=pending.
8. Message/get: { ids: [<id from step 7>] } → assert list[0].body == "hello", list[0].chatId == chatId.
9. Message/changes: { sinceState: "s-0" } → assert created list contains message ID.
10. Message/query: { chatId: <chatId> } → assert IDs list contains message ID.

Defensive invariants tested:
- Message with oversized body (>65536) → notCreated with invalidArguments
- Message with wrong chatId → notCreated with invalidArguments
- Contact/changes with malformed sinceState → methodResponse error cannotCalculateChanges or invalidArguments

Oracle: All expected values are hand-constructed from RFC 8620 spec; no values derived from code under test. Response shapes verified against RFC 8620 §5.x field names (camelCase, exact type).

Agent team:
- Agent R: Read existing integration tests in kith-store/src/ for test helper patterns. Read kithd/src/main.rs for router construction.
- Agent I: Implement E2E test in kith-chat/tests/e2e.rs or kithd/tests/e2e.rs.
- Agent T: Independently derive expected JMAP field names and values from RFC 8620 text. Verify no oracle comes from code output.
- Agent V: cargo test --workspace passes, clippy clean.
